analysis_md: 因为 $P=P(x,y),Q=-Q(x,y)$；所以 $\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=-\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}$
search_text: 表达式 $P(x,y)dx-Q(x,y)dy$ 为某个函数的全微分的充分必要条件是（ ） $\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}$ $\frac{\partial P}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}$ $\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=-\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}$ $\frac{\partial P}{\partial x}=-\frac{\partial Q}{\partial y}$ 因为 $P=P(x,y),Q=-Q(x,y)$；所以 $\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=-\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}$
